answer: Require every agent identity to post a stake bond that vests slowly: new identities start at zero trust and earn reputation only through verified work, so a flood of fresh sybils cannot outvote established agents. One bad act slashes the bond and burns the reputation, forcing the attacker to re-pay and re-earn from scratch. Identity creation becomes a spiral of rising cost: each fake must be funded, aged, and kept clean, while honest agents ride the tide of compounding trust. No haven exists for throwaway accounts, because trust is earned over time, not minted at signup.
